name: blake-pe
description: Connect your own SMTP/IMAP email accounts on Mac. Choose a sender, send authorized email and read each connected Inbox.

interface.shortDescription: Your email accounts, together on your Mac.
interface.longDescription: Connect your own SMTP/IMAP mailboxes with password or app-password authentication through a native macOS dialog. Select the sender for each email and the account for Inbox reading. SMTP supports TLS or STARTTLS; IMAP uses TLS. Passwords remain in your Mac Keychain. OAuth sign-in is not included.
defaultPrompt: Help me connect my own mailbox.
Show unread mail in an account I choose.
Prepare an email and let me choose the sender.
